Hi Alicia — great to hear the demo was useful. Quick answers and a couple of operational options we can offer: 

1) On-demand top-up (credit bucket): we can add a one-time promo top-up to the LaunchBridge account that is subject to a post-period reconciliation. That top-up would be applied immediately and reduce billing volatility for you. We typically require a signed MOU for any retroactive allocation above the standard promo (simple one-pager).

2) Convert excess into a short-term dedicated discount: we can create a 30-day Dedicated Discount pass (reserved capacity credit) at a negotiated discount percentage. This requires minimum commitment to a short billing window and approval from our finance team — typically a 14–21 day lead time for provisioning if you need dedicated GPUs.

3) Packaging constraints: the main bottleneck is legal (SOW/MOU) + finance signoff for discounts. For the credit top-up, we can operate under a standard accelerator addendum (no new PO required) and reconcile after cohort close. For dedicated conversion, we need a PO and may require a short redline on the order form.

Suggested approach for speed:
- Option A (fast): We add a one-time promo top-up of 50k token-equivalent credits to cover the expected burst. You sign the accelerator addendum (we can DocuSign today).
- Option B (capacity): If you expect sustained burst beyond week 2, we provision a 30-day discounted reserved pool; require PO and ~10 business days.

I’ve attached a preliminary pricing sheet (redwood_topup_pricing_v1.xlsx) with example tiers. If you’re comfortable with Option A I’ll send the addendum for signature and route it through finance.

Best,

Hi team—

Thanks Mina, Alicia. For transparency on pricing mechanics, here's the structure I recommend based on similar cohorts we've run: 

- One-time top-up: 50k credit top-up (covers ~2x expected burst) at no additional cash charge, with reconciliation if usage exceeds 75k (we invoice incremental usage at promo-adjusted rate).
- Milestone top-up: split the top-up into two tranches (30k on cohort start, 20k at midpoint) tied to usage thresholds — reduces unused-credit risk for both sides.
- Dedicated conversion: for conversions, propose a 25% off list price on a 30-day reserved allocation; finance will require a PO and an internal credit waiver if the discount >20%.

If LaunchBridge wants to proceed with the one-time top-up and the simple addendum, we can fast-track. Otherwise, milestone approach is my preference to balance risk.

Lauren — tagging you for approval on the conditional reconciliation language (we'd like to avoid month-long open-ended invoices).
